title: Shattered Crystal Sphere
description: A large transparent crystal sphere sits on an ornate purple and gold pedestal. The sphere is dramatically shattered with cracks radiating from a bright central light source, revealing a painted landscape of green hills, a winding river, snow-capped purple mountains, and stylized purple flowers against a dark blue background.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a large transparent crystal sphere resting on an ornate purple and gold pedestal against a solid dark navy background. The sphere is dramatically cracked and shattered with white fracture lines radiating from a brilliant star-like light burst at its center. Inside the sphere is a vibrant painted landscape showing rolling green hills, a winding blue river, and distant purple snow-capped mountains. Stylized purple flowers and fan-like patterns float within the sphere. The sphere shows colorful light refractions and prismatic effects along the cracks.
